svg.title: ERP | Actors and core use cases

g.text: ERP | Actors and core use cases
Staff teaching actions require assigned offering.
Admin and super-admin may manage offerings.
UI route guard authenticates; page-level checks
show student/staff content or explicit placeholders.
Attestation is manual, not automated tax validation.
Tenant context is required for ordinary mutations.
Actors describe permissions, not implemented admin screens.
«include»: required behavior; arrow points to the included use case
«extend»: optional behavior; arrow points to the base use case
Viewing grades does not require an appeal; registration checks prerequisites.
